basic_info.description: 2952-2960 Folsom Street & 69 Horace Alley is a two-building apartment complex on one lot in the highly desirable Mission District of San Francisco. The property comprises: 2952-2960 Folsom Street: An eight-unit apartment building featuring two-bedroom configurations, complemented by six on-site parking spaces. 69 Horace Alley: A versatile live/work space encompassing approximately 2,925 square feet. The property has undergone a soft-story seismic retrofit, ensuring compliance with San Francisco's soft story ordinance. Furthermore, approved plans are in place to develop three additional dwelling units (ADUs) at 69 Horace Alley and two ADUs at the Folsom Street building, significantly enhancing the property's value and income potential.
